add_default_dances: add default jump, konami dance, and head bob dances to the agent memory
generate_sequential_move_fn: generate a move function from a sequence of dance move dictionaries for an agent
Movement_class: create a Movement object with an agent and move function to get sequential dance moves
RefObjMovement_class: create a RefObjMovement to move an agent clockwise or anticlockwise around a reference object
RefObjMovement_get_move: get the next move along a precomputed circular path around a reference object
